title: Keflavik, Reykjanes — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Keflavik, Reykjanes: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Keflavik is a city in Reykjanes with a population of 16,000. Iceland’s international gateway city, home to Keflavik Airport and a growing community of remote workers. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 125 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
